AIM Workshop “Pólya-Schur-Lax Problems: Hyperbolicity and Stability
Preservers” — A List of Open Problems
record.original_question: If P(x0,…,xm) is a real homogeneous polynomial hyperbolic with respect to c and L is a real linear form with L(c)≠0, must some power L^N·P admit a determinantal representation det(x0A0+…+xmAm) with real symmetric matrices and the stated positivity condition?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $P(x_0, x_1, \dots, x_m)$ be a real homogeneous polynomial of degree $d$, and let $c = (c_0, c_1, \dots, c_m) \in \mathbb{R}^{m+1}$ be a point with $P(c) \neq 0$. Recall that $P$ is hyperbolic with respect to $c$ if for every $x \in \mathbb{R}^{m+1}$ the univariate polynomial $t \mapsto P(x - tc)$ has only real roots. The hyperbolicity cone $\Lambda_+(P,c)$ is the connected component of $\{x \in \mathbb{R}^{m+1} : P(x) \neq 0\}$ containing $c$.

Let $L(x_0, \dots, x_m)$ be a real linear form with $L(c) > 0$ that is hyperbolic with respect to $c$ (equivalently, $L$ is nonnegative on $\overline{\Lambda_+(P,c)}$ in a sense compatible with stability).

Question: Does there exist a positive integer $N$ and real symmetric matrices $A_0, A_1, \dots, A_m$ such that
$$L(x_0, \dots, x_m)^N \cdot P(x_0, \dots, x_m) = \det(x_0 A_0 + x_1 A_1 + \cdots + x_m A_m),$$
with the additional positivity condition that $c_0 A_0 + c_1 A_1 + \cdots + c_m A_m$ is positive definite?
artifact.status_search_result: The naive conjecture that some power of a hyperbolic polynomial admits a definite determinantal representation is known to be false in general (Brändén and others gave counterexamples). The closely related generalized Lax conjecture (spectrahedrality of hyperbolicity cones) remains open. The specific "stable" multiplier-by-linear-form variant remains an open problem in the literature.

status_evidence.title: Hyperbolic polynomials and the generalized Lax conjecture
status_evidence.snippet: One guess was that always some power h^r of a hyperbolic polynomial admits a definite determinantal representation. This... turns out to be false in general.
status_evidence.claim: The power-multiplier version (without an external linear form) is false; the generalized Lax conjecture remains open.

status_evidence.title: Lecture 23: General Lax Conjecture & its Variants
status_evidence.snippet: The generalized Lax conjecture remains wide open.
status_evidence.claim: The generalized Lax conjecture and its variants are open.

status_evidence.title: Exponential Lower Bounds on Spectrahedral Representations
status_evidence.snippet: Lower bounds on sizes of spectrahedral representations of hyperbolicity cones.
status_evidence.claim: Quantitative obstructions exist but the qualitative conjecture is unresolved.
